description: $0.014 — Call this to catch contrarian setups as a liquidation cascade builds. Fires only when Hyperliquid liquidation pressure is extreme (>80/100) AND top wallets are heavily crowded on one side (>70) with their liquidations within 5% of price. Returns cascade_risk, contrarian_setup (LONG/SHORT, fading the crowd), a heuristic probability_estimate and a suggested_entry_zone, target and invalidation from the liquidation clusters. Param: coin=BTC|ETH|SOL (default BTC)

coin.description: Asset to check: BTC, ETH or SOL (default BTC)

name: capitulation_alert
